question: In the Grand Rapids General Retirement System investment consultant RFP, what was the total market value of the General Retirement System and as of what date?
gold_answer: Approximately $437 million as of June 30, 2023 (the separate Grand Rapids Police and Fire Retirement System covered by the same RFP was approximately $479 million).
acceptance: Require $437m approximately and June 30, 2023. Separate Police and Fire amount is optional.
candidate_answer: The General Retirement System’s total market value was approximately **$437 million as of June 30, 2023**. [Source: Investment Consultant RFP, p. 1](Grand_Rapids_GRS__Investment-Consultant-RFP-2023.pdf#page=1)
